proof:
The determinants of the three successive vertex vectors in the stated order are $412,392,419$. Their sum is twice the area; dividing the corresponding opposite determinants by this sum gives the positive barycentric coordinates of zero. The margins in the three rows at those vertices are respectively $(-15,16,-2)$, $(-22,-4,25)$ and $(37,-12,-23)$. Thus each cap is a vertex triangle. For one positive apex value $h$ and negative values $-r,-s$, the two edge intercept fractions from the apex are $h/(h+r)$ and $h/(h+s)$, so its area fraction is $h^2/[(h+r)(h+s)]$. This gives the three displayed fractions.

Linear interpolation at the two crossed edges gives the interval of $y$ on $x=0$ as $[-412/31,196/9]$, of $x$ on $y=0$ as $[-419/47,392/29]$, and of $x$ on $x+y=0$ as $[-419/60,412/49]$. In the last case, Euclidean lengths are $\sqrt2$ times the differences of these coordinates, and the normal has norm $\sqrt2$. In the first two cases the normal has unit norm. Taking the differences and the shorter-to-longer ratios gives the table. Cross-multiplication yields $q_i<47/100$ and $\rho_i>3/5>1/\sqrt3$ for all $i$. Also $\sigma_1-2\sigma_3=585817/136710>0$, and $(1/\sigma_1)/\sum_i(1/\sigma_i)=258075/1249523<2/9$ by cross-multiplication. The sorted cap profile here exceeds one by $50296111/1490685840>0$; this follows by substituting $q_3=\max_i q_i$ into $q_1+q_2+q_3/4-1$.

statement:
Let $K=\operatorname{conv}\{(-15,-22),(16,-4),(-2,25)\}$ and use the source $0$ and the spanning normals $v_1=(1,0)$, $v_2=(0,1)$, $v_3=(-1,-1)$, whose sum is zero. The source is interior and $|K|=1223/2$. For the through-source caps, let $q_i$ be the ordinary area fractions, $\sigma_i$ the chord lengths divided by $\lVert v_i\rVert$, and $\rho_i$ the ratios of shorter to longer distances from the source to the chord endpoints. Then
$$
\begin{aligned}
(q_1,q_2,q_3)&=(128/279,625/1363,1369/2940),\\
(\sigma_1,\sigma_2,\sigma_3)&=(9784/279,30575/1363,45251/2940),\\
(\rho_1,\rho_2,\rho_3)&=(927/1519,12151/18424,20531/24720).
\end{aligned}
$$
All three $q_i<47/100$ and all three $\rho_i>1/\sqrt3$, but $\sigma_1>2\sigma_3$ and the first normalized reciprocal chord weight is $258075/1249523<2/9$.
title: Small cap fractions and near-bisected chords do not balance ordinary section weights
